name: short-sin-dormir
description: YouTube Short: ¿Qué pasaría si dejaras de dormir? (Remotion)

scripts.render: remotion render SinDormir out/short.raw.mp4 && ffmpeg -v error -y -i out/short.raw.mp4 -c:v copy -af loudnorm=I=-15:TP=-1.5:LRA=11 -ar 48000 -c:a aac -b:a 192k out/short.mp4 && rm out/short.raw.mp4
